opening: Lord, meet us gently today and always
body:
Lord, I don’t know what You are doing. I don’t know why this has become so heavy. I don’t even know how to pray anymore. If Your Spirit is praying for me, let that be enough today. Carry me until I can walk toward You again.

Romans 8 ends the same chapter that says the Spirit intercedes for us but it also says:

“Neither death nor life… nor anything else in all creation will be able to separate us from the love of God in Christ Jesus our Lord.”

Your grip on God may feel weak today.
Romans 8 is not about the strength of your grip.
It is about the strength of His.
